alt: 男子把摔碎陶器的殘片藏進櫃裡，一面擋住櫃門、一面向同伴示意保密，門口訪客滿臉疑惑。
scene_prompt: In a community workshop an adult manager has secretly caused a valuable ceramic display to shatter. Broken fragments remain partly visible inside a heavy lockable cabinet he urgently closes; his body blocks the view while he presses a finger to his lips toward a knowing accomplice. Visitors at the open doorway ask with puzzled faces and open palms; he gives them a tight evasive smile. Emphasize deliberate concealment of this incident from others, no private diary, no readable documents.
